part7.title: Bài đọc 3 (Câu 151 - 152)
part7.passageText:
Upton Science Center: A New Gallery Is on Its Way
This winter, the Upton Science Center will add the Wind and Rain Gallery, a permanent space where visitors can create their own small storms and test how buildings stand up to strong winds. The gallery opens to the public on the second Saturday of the new year.
Before then, you can get an early look at the work in progress. On one Saturday morning in each of August, September, and October, the construction area will be open for viewing. Guests will watch from a safe distance as our exhibit team builds the gallery's largest displays.
Viewing mornings are free, but places fill quickly, so please reserve a ticket at www.uptonscience.org.

To: All Staff
From: Dennis Stroud, Human Resources Director
Date: June 4
Subject: Welcome, Yolanda Mercer
I am pleased to announce that Yolanda Mercer has joined our training team as a learning specialist. Many of you met her when she interviewed with us last month.
Before coming here, Ms. Mercer spent eight years in hotel management. In her new role, she will design and lead skills courses for employees in every department.
Her first open workshop, on presentation skills, will take place on June 18 in Training Room 2. Space is limited, so please call extension 4150 by June 11 to sign up. Ms. Mercer will describe her planned courses at next month's staff meeting.
Dennis Stroud

part7.passageText:
Came Through When I Needed It Most
Rating: 5 out of 5 stars
Posted by Rosemary Quinn on February 19
For nearly ten years, I have taken my work shoes to Everett Shoe Repair whenever they need attention. My father first recommended the shop to me, and I have never had a reason to go anywhere else. --[1]--. The work is careful and the prices fair. In its busiest months, the shop takes repairs by appointment only, so I always book ahead at that time of year. --[2]--.
Last week, I broke a heel on my way to an important client meeting and went straight to the shop. --[3]--. When I explained my situation, Dmitri Hale set aside the booking rule for me. He asked his assistant, Joy, to cover the counter, moved one scheduled job to the next morning, and fixed my heel himself while a leather supplier unloaded a delivery. My shoe was ready in forty minutes, and I reached my meeting on time.
I will keep coming back and have already told my colleagues about the shop. --[4]--. Everett Shoe Repair has my highest recommendation.

Northway Sports Team Partner Program
Easier ordering for school and club teams
About the Program
Northway Sports has supplied uniforms and equipment to local teams since it opened its first store in 2004. Today, with fourteen stores across the region, we are launching the Team Partner Program to simplify team ordering. "I coached youth soccer for ten years before joining Northway, so I know how much time volunteers spend chasing orders," says Teresa Novak, who manages our team sales department. --[1]--.
Member Benefits
Every member club receives priority handling of its orders, a direct phone line to our team sales advisers, and group price quotes within one business day. --[2]--. Orders of ten or more matching shirts are printed with player names and numbers in our own workshop at no charge.
Who Can Join
The program is open to any registered sports club, league, or school team. --[3]--. Clubs expecting to spend under $3,000 a year join at the Standard level, and those spending more join at the Plus level, which adds free delivery to their practice field.
How to Apply
To apply, complete the online form on this page and upload a copy of your club's registration document. Our team sales staff review every application within five business days. --[4]--. Approved clubs are then mailed a welcome kit with a member card and a printed catalog of team products.
Questions? Call our team sales department at 555-0133 or write to
[email protected]
.

part7.passageText:
Pembury Nature Network to Extend Otter Creek Tree-Planting Program
KELSALL (May 14) — The Pembury Nature Network announced today that its tree-planting program along Otter Creek will continue to grow this summer. The nonprofit group, which has worked to protect local waterways for more than a decade, plans to extend the program beyond the section of the creek where planting began.
When the program was launched six months ago, the group ordered 400 young trees and invited area residents to help plant them along the banks of the creek. Organizers hoped that the invitation would attract about 50 volunteers, enough to finish the work by the end of the season.
By the end of the first month, more than 300 people had registered. Groups from three local schools and a neighborhood running club also joined the effort, often bringing twenty or more helpers to a single session. "We had to order extra trees twice," said Carol Jessup, the program's coordinator. "The creek banks where we started are now almost fully planted."
To keep up with demand, the network has reached an agreement with the town to open two neighboring areas of land along the creek for planting. Together, they will make room for about 600 more trees. The first volunteer session at the new sites will be held on June 21, and tools and gloves will be provided.
Residents who wish to take part can register at www.pemburynature.org.

Mulberry Court Apartments: A Guide to Shared Spaces
Welcome to Mulberry Court, Ms. Okonkwo. This sheet introduces the shared spaces that come with your apartment and explains how residents use them. Your lease already covers the rules for Apartment 4B itself, while the areas below are shared with your neighbors.
The ground-floor lounge offers comfortable seating, free wireless Internet access and a small kitchen area. There is no charge to use it, and residents may reserve it through the management office to host private
functions
.
Next to the lounge is the laundry room, with eight washers and eight dryers that accept payment by card. The room is open daily from 7:00 A.M. to 10:00 P.M. The machines are cleaned once a week, so a few may be unavailable for short periods.
Quiet hours are observed throughout the building from 10:00 P.M. to 7:00 A.M., and during this time we ask residents to keep voices and music low in hallways and shared areas. Guests are welcome in the lounge and laundry room when accompanied by a resident.
A map of the building is attached, showing each shared space along with the elevators and exits. We hope you will soon feel at home here. If you have any questions or notice a problem in a shared space, please contact the management office.

Moreland Plant Rentals
Our Plant Collections for Offices
Every Moreland collection is leased by the month and includes regular care visits from our staff, who water, trim, and replace any plant that stops looking its best. Choose the collection that fits each room.
Compact Collection
These are small plants sized for individual desks and counters. Each one comes in a self-watering pot that holds about two weeks of water. The plants do best within a few steps of a window.
Low Light Collection
These medium-sized plants suit shelves, tables, and filing cabinets. They grow well under ordinary ceiling lights alone, which makes them a good choice for inner rooms that receive no daylight.
Floor Standing Collection
These tall plants in large pots bring life to entrances, reception areas, and open work areas. Because of their size, they are delivered by a two-person team, and a one-time setup charge applies.
Seasonal Color Collection
This collection features flowering plants that we replace with new varieties every three months. It is offered only as an addition to one of the collections above.
To arrange a free visit from one of our advisors, call 555-0172 or visit www.morelandplants.com.
----------------------
Customer Stories
Rachel Townsend, Office Manager, Kessler Accounting
We first called Moreland three years ago about the meeting room in the middle of our floor. It had no windows, and the plants we had bought for it kept dying within weeks. The ones Moreland set on its table and shelves stayed healthy. Last spring, we moved into a larger building with a wide open work area, and the space felt empty and cold. That is why I got in touch with Moreland again, and their advisor suggested adding several tall plants, which our staff have been happy with ever since. The weekly visits are quick and never interrupt our work. My advice to other office managers is to show the advisor every room during the first visit, not just the ones clients see, because the back offices often need plants the most. I would recommend Moreland to any business.

TO: All members, Tollgate Community Band
FROM: Beatrice Sandoval, Committee Chair
DATE: May 8
SUBJECT: Spring concert
Our spring concert will take place on June 15, and before the committee books a stage and orders printed music, it needs an accurate count of players. Please complete the enclosed form, indicating whether you can attend all five rehearsals as well as the performance itself, and return it to me.
At our last members' meeting, each of you placed four possible concert themes in order of preference: marches, songs from stage musicals, dance music, and film music. The committee has now counted every list. For several years, one request has appeared in your written comments more often than any other, and the results show that it is still the clear favorite. The June program will therefore be made up entirely of music from well-known films.
Where we perform depends on your replies. If at least 30 players confirm by May 20, we will play on the outdoor stage in Quarry Hill Park, where a full band can be heard clearly across the lawn. With fewer players, the concert will move to the smaller hall at Vance Street Library. Flyers will be printed as soon as the location is settled, so please do not wait until the deadline to respond.
Beatrice Sandoval
----------------------
Music from the Movies
A Spring Concert by the Tollgate Community Band
June 15, 6:30 P.M. | Outdoor Stage, Quarry Hill Park
Spend a June evening in the park with the Tollgate Community Band. The
program
features music from more than a dozen well-known films, from classic adventure stories to recent family favorites. Every member of the band is a local volunteer, and the players have prepared these pieces especially for this evening.
Admission is free, and no tickets are needed. Seating is on the lawn, so please bring a blanket or a folding chair. The concert lasts about ninety minutes. For directions and updates, visit www.tollgateband.org.

Staff at our office near Linley Park enjoyed one of your walks last year and still talk about it. Early next month, our company is hosting sixteen guests, and we would like them to have a walk of their own.

Best regards,
Alan Reyes
Events Coordinator, Hartman Engineering
----------------------
Private Walks for Groups
Organizations may book most walks as a private tour with the walk's usual guide. Requests must arrive at least three weeks before the chosen date, and groups must have 8 to 20 people. Walks held outdoors throughout are the one exception and accept up to 35, because the buildings on other routes limit how many people may enter at once.
To arrange a private walk:
1. Choose a walk and a date.
2. Complete the request form at www.corbridgevisitors.org/groups.
3. Within three working days, we will e-mail you the guide's confirmation and a payment link.
4. Pay the $240 fee through that link within seven days to hold your date.

Redfern Digital
Online marketing that grows with your business
Redfern Digital offers four service plans for small and mid-size businesses. Every plan includes one account manager who knows your business and a clear report on your results at the end of each month.
Quick Start
This plan creates your business profiles on the major search and map Web sites and keeps them up to date. It can be arranged for as little as one month.
Neighborhood
Built for shops and restaurants that serve customers in one area, this plan helps nearby people find your business in local search results and through targeted online advertising. The minimum term is three months.
Momentum
Businesses ready to reach new customers online choose Momentum for regular social media posts and monthly e-mail campaigns. Clients sign up for at least six months.
Summit
Our most complete plan adds a redesigned Web site and advertising across several regions to everything above. Because results build over time, Summit requires a twelve-month agreement.
To find the right plan for you, book a free consultation at www.redferndigital.com.

To: Amelia Grant
From: Carlos Medina
Date: July 2
Subject: Second-quarter figures
Hi Amelia,
The local businesses we signed up this spring are settling in well, but the quarterly summary points to a bigger opportunity. The clients who must commit to a full year with us keep asking for more work, and the two specialists handling their accounts are fully booked until the fall.
I would therefore like to hire a third specialist for these accounts before the end of the summer. Each of these clients brings in far more per month than those on our other plans, so I believe the added salary would be covered quickly. If you agree, I can have a job posting ready next week.
Could we find fifteen minutes this week to talk it over?
Thanks,
Carlos Medina
Client Services Director
